messages:
raj: Heads up — noticed a sharp tail-latency spike in eu-west dedicated pool around 11:02 UTC. Router logs show ~120 small-tenant allocations spilled into shared nodes for ~15m.

ellie: I see it. Telemetry shows our GPU util sampling collapsed (1s -> 30s) during that window for the eu-west metrics pipeline, so the scheduler's bin-packing thought slots were free.

noah: Can you paste the router log slice?

raj: Sure, here's the relevant chunk (trimmed):

```
2026-03-19T11:02:05Z router.v2 INFO routing decision: tenant=t-347 spill=true target_pool=shared-eu-west reason=util_estimate=0.12 sampled_at=2026-03-19T11:01:36Z
2026-03-19T11:02:08Z scheduler WARN node=node-45 gpuload=0.15 last_sample_age=29s
2026-03-19T11:12:10Z router.v2 INFO backfill completed spilled=118
```

raj: trace_id=trace-eu-20260319-11:02 attached.

deploy-bot: :warning: Alert fired: routing-mismatch-eu-west (slo: dedicated-isolation). Incident ticket #INC-5231 created.

ellie: Root cause hypothesis: downsampling in metrics pipeline (prometheus remote write -> aggregator) caused stale util estimates. Scheduler uses those estimates for soft-spill decisions. When sampling gap >15s we should stop spillovers to protect dedicated pools.

noah: Immediate mitigation proposals: 1) set router.v2.spillThreshold -> 0.85 for eu-west (harder to spill) 2) temporarily pin heavy tenants back to reserved lanes 3) cordon noisy shared nodes until stats catch up. Which can we do quickly?

raj: I can push the spillThreshold change and cordon low-priority shared nodes. Lowering spill aggressiveness is safest now.

ellie: Longer-term: increase telemetry sampling frequency for 'dedicated' tag and add a sampling-health alert. But note the cost: higher cardinality. Alternative: add dedicated pool probes (light synthetic traffic) so scheduler has a fresh signal without full-cardinality metrics.

noah: I'll test the probe idea in canary. For the short-term I will deploy the router tweak. Command: `k8s apply -f router-config-eu-west-spill-20260319.yaml` -> ci link: https://ci.redwood/1234

opsbot: deploy-bot: rollout started for router.v2 (eu-west) by noah. Canary 10% -> 100% in 6m if green.

ellie: Also add billing tag 'spill_event=eu-west-20260319' to reconcile cost anomalies for tenants moved to shared. Finance should get a digest. cc @billing-team (will open invoice ticket).

raj: Action items summarized: 
- raj: apply cordon/eviction on identified shared nodes & add sampling-latency alert (>=10s).
- noah: deploy router.v2 spillThreshold change + run dedicated-probe canary.
- ellie: owner of postmortem + billing reconciliation ticket.

noah: ack. Will post canary logs and link when done.

deploy-bot: rollout successful: router.v2 eu-west spillThreshold=0.85 -> 100% (2026-03-19T11:08:01Z).

raj: early signal looks good — no more backfills in last 7m. Keep monitoring for 2 hours then close.

ellie: filing the postmortem now with timeline + recommend: 1) sampling SLA for dedicated metric paths, 2) targeted synthetic probes, 3) router guard to reject spill if sample_age>15s.

noah: uploading canary results to the incident ticket.

raj: thanks all. We'll revisit quota/costing implications during postmortem. :thumbsup:
